scope: Original repository tests, in-memory SQLite D1 substitutes and mocked external requests; analysis-only Python path/UTF-8 adapter; fail-closed unmocked fetch. No production network or D1 integration and no deployment approval implied.

priorAttempt.cause: Windows Python stdout default cp949 was decoded as UTF-8 by the original JS fixture runner; 북풍 rendered as replacement characters. Final rerun sets PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 and PYTHONUTF8=1 without altering tests.
priorAttempt.provenanceCaveat: Initial helper git-show hashing used insufficient default maxBuffer; initial content-difference assertions were invalid. Final helper uses 16MiB and checks subprocess errors.

limitations: The original regression suite intentionally reads held P1-A 18:10/18:19 weather_week from the analysis checkout. It does not represent the latest 21:04/21:08 weather or prove ecological quality/safety beyond declared test conditions. Latest-input actual190 comparison is separately documented in p1b-independent-review.md.
